```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE,dpi=1400, out.width="95%", fig.width=8, fig.height=8}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(cowplot)


#Read data and plot it in an Rmarkdown
tree_family_interactions = readRDS("../../Data/Manuscript_info/plant_phylo.RData")
d1 = readRDS("../../Data/Manuscript_info/plant_coverage_phylo_RData")

#Check if there are differences in labels and order
ggtree(tree_family_interactions, layout="circular", size=0.15, open.angle=5, alpha=0.25) +
  geom_fruit(data = d1, geom=geom_bar,
             mapping=aes(y=label, x=Percent, fill = fam_group),
             pwidth=0.1, 
             orientation="y", 
             stat="identity",
             color="black",
             offset = 0.028,
             linewidth=0.35,
             axis.params=list(
               axis = "x",
               text.size  = 1.5,
               hjust  = 0.8,
               vjust = 0.4,
               nbreak = 3,
               fontface = 2),
             grid.params=list())+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(A = "lightgrey", B = "tan2"), guide = "none") +
  new_scale_fill() +
  geom_tippoint(aes(size= Interactions, fill = Interactions), color="black", shape=21) +
  geom_tiplab(linetype='dashed', linesize=.05, offset = -5, size=1.85, fontface=2, hjust=1) +
  scale_size(range = c(0,4), guide = 'none') +
  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis", direction=-1,breaks = c(3, 6, 9)) + 
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=c(3/1.7, 6/1.7, 9/1.7)),
                        title.hjust = 0.5,
                        keywidth = 1,                        # Increase width of fill legend keys
                        keyheight = 2,                     # Increase height of fill legend keys
                        label.theme = element_text(size = 14) # Scale up fill label text size
    ),
    size = guide_legend(
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      keywidth = 1,                        # Increase width of size legend keys
      keyheight = 2,                     # Increase height of size legend keys
      label.theme = element_text(size = 14) # Scale up size label text size
    )) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(), size = guide_legend()) +
  geom_fruit(geom=geom_bar,
             mapping=aes(y=label, x=log(Spp_Europe +1)),
             pwidth=0.1, 
             orientation="y", 
             stat="identity",
             color="black",
             offset = 0,
             linewidth=0.35,
             axis.params=list(
               axis = "x",
               text.size  = 1.5,
               hjust  = 0.45,
               vjust = 4,
               offset = 0,
               nbreak = 4,
               fontface = 2),
             grid.params=list()) +
  theme(legend.margin=unit(1,"cm"),
        legend.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
        plot.margin = margin(4,0,4,0), 
        legend.position = c(0.5,0.085),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, 'cm'), ) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y =0, label = "Coverage", size= 1.3, fontface= "bold",
           vjust=1.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 162.5, y =0, label = "Eu. spp", size= 1.3, fontface= "bold",
           vjust=2.55) 

```
